jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Growth - Retention
jobs.description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Growth Product team and own critical strategic areas of how we retain members. The role will be tasked with improving trial conversion rate and member retention rate through experimentation with a team of dedicated engineering, design, analytics, and lifecycle marketing resources.

 

Initiatives that this role could own include, but are not limited to: onboarding, gamification, community network effects, loyalty, ecosystem, involuntary churn, and business model development. This role will be expected to operate as a self-sufficient strategic leader who translates vague concepts in these areas into customer and business value and partners closely with executive stakeholders in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.


The ideal candidate will have experience with consumer subscription products, mobile app development, connecting product work to business outcomes, and possess new core competencies that will uplevel the Growth Product team and the business.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Develop and maintain the product strategy for several areas at once that pertain to trial conversion or member retention.

 - Own KPIs over the long term — exhibit mastery of the member experience, prioritize how best to improve it, and make roadmap decisions to ensure the business is hitting its ambitious growth goals.

 - Lead end-to-end product discovery, delivery, and iteration — contributing across research, ideation, requirements, prototyping, and testing — and partner deeply with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Lifecycle Marketing to ship high-impact solutions on accelerated timelines.

 - Design and run a rigorous experimentation program: form explicit hypotheses, validate assumptions, structure A/B tests, and translate learnings into a compounding roadmap of wins.

 - Write crisp product requirement documents and operate as the directly responsible individual for execution quality from discovery through launch and post-launch iteration.

 - Act as the strategic voice for the customer — speak to member needs, pain points, and behavior better than anyone else in the company, and translate that depth into product decisions and cross-functional alignment.

 - Anticipate complexity and proactively de-risk long-term initiatives through smart scoping, phasing, and technical foresight in partnership with Engineering.

 - Partner with Marketing, Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to influence company-level growth strategy and align cross-functional initiatives around your roadmap.

 - Raise the bar for product craft by bringing new core competencies in at least one of the following spaces: onboarding, gamification, community network effects, loyalty, ecosystem, involuntary churn, and business model development.

 - Contribute to and improve the best practices of the team and look for ways to improve the team’s operating cadence and camaraderie.



QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 5–8+ years of product management experience (or equivalent in growth/related roles) with a track record of multiple shipped products that produced measurable, long-term business impact.

 - Demonstrated ability to develop coherent product strategy from ambiguous problem spaces and then translating strategy into phased, executable roadmaps. Ideally in the space of at least one of the following: onboarding, gamification, community network effects, loyalty, ecosystem, involuntary churn, and business model development.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; highly proficient in product analytics tools (Amplitude, Sigma, or equivalent) and able to independently pull, model, and interpret data without analyst support.

 - Direct experience with consumer subscription products, digital consumer growth funnels, and best-in-class onboarding, gamification, and/or social mechanics including running structured experimentation programs at scale.

 - Deep customer empathy and product intuition paired with a rigorous, data-informed mindset; able to read between the lines of customer feedback and form/validate hypotheses explicitly.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication; proven ability to influence executive stakeholders, drive alignment across senior cross-functional partners, and articulate trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Completely self-sufficient and known for being highly dependable; comfortable defining problems, structuring approaches, and driving clarity in fast-moving, loosely-defined spaces.

 - Track record of mentoring more junior PMs and raising the craft bar of the teams around you.

 - Highly organized, adaptable, and energized by a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

 - Passionate about fitness, wellness, and the mission of WHOOP.

 - Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, especially in harnessing data to make quick and well-informed decisions, and ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring Product Analysts to embed across the product organization and serve as strategic analytics partners to teams across Healthcare, Algorithms, AI, Hardware, and other product areas. In this role, you will help define how WHOOP measures product success, uncover insights that shape roadmap decisions, and translate complex data into clear recommendations that improve the member experience. You will bring strong analytical rigor, product intuition, and intellectual curiosity to help teams make faster, smarter, and more impactful decisions with data.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Design, and cross-functional leadership to inform strategy and roadmap decisions with data.

 - Own the analytical narrative for your product area, illustrated by defining KPIs, refining measurement frameworks, and surfacing insights that drive action.

 - Support experimentation and feature launches end-to-end: from defining success metrics to post-launch analysis and iteration.

 - Build scalable, self-serve reporting & tooling that lets your stakeholders make decisions without waiting on you.

 - Develop deep context on your product domain and use it to ask sharper questions, challenge assumptions, and push the product forward.

 - Proactively surface insights and recommendations that go beyond the ask; identify opportunities others haven't seen yet.

 - Collaborate with a high-performance analytics team in a fast-paced environment where intellectual curiosity is the baseline expectation.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - You've done this before: 2-6+ years in an analytical role where you owned business-critical metrics or initiatives. (We're hiring across levels; we'll figure out the right fit together.)

 - You use AI tools proactively and hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own.

 - You can take a vague question, wrangle the right data, isolate insights, and communicate actionable recommendations to stakeholders who aren't data people.

 - You're a strong storyteller: you know how to make a compelling, concise case for action.

 - You're technically sharp: advanced SQL is table stakes. Familiarity with modern data stacks (Snowflake, dbt, ELT workflows) and visualization tools (Hex, Sigma, Amplitude, Looker) is a plus.

 - You have product sense: you think about the member experience, not just the numbers.

 - You're curious about how things work. Algorithms, hardware, health science: you don't need to be an expert, but you should want to understand.

 - You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and doesn't wait to be told what to work on.

 - TEAMS WE'RE HIRING FOR
   
   We’re looking for multiple analysts to work across our product teams. During the interview process, we'll work with you to find the right team fit based on your interests and strengths:
   
   - AI Product: The future of intelligent coaching and personalized insights powered by AI/ML.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

The AI team at WHOOP turns continuous physiological data into recommendations members act on every day. The quality of that intelligence is the product, and as it reaches more members across more surfaces, the work of measuring it, choosing the models behind it, understanding what it costs, and giving the rest of the company the tooling to build on it has grown into a role of its own.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Product Manager to work at that layer, alongside our AI engineers, research scientists, and data scientists. The work spans how AI output quality gets measured and enforced, which models and providers power which experiences, the internal AI platform that teams across WHOOP use to build agents, and which emerging techniques from the research world are worth a bet.

This is a platform-oriented AI product role. Your users are as often internal (agent authors, analysts, engineers, research scientists) as they are members. It suits someone technical enough to earn the trust of ML researchers, organized enough to run a program across several teams without direct authority, and disciplined enough to say no to most of what is possible.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Shape how AI output quality is measured across WHOOP's AI experiences, including the evaluation methodology, datasets, and scoring that make quality continuous and trusted rather than judged case by case.

 - Build the evaluation habit across the company: make evals self-serve, and get the teams shipping AI features to actually run them.

 - Help decide which models power which experiences, and which providers we run them on, balancing quality, latency, and cost as the model landscape shifts.

 - Product-manage our internal AI development platform and drive its adoption, so that anyone at WHOOP building with AI has a fast, well-instrumented path from idea to shipped.

 - Track the unit economics of AI at WHOOP, including cost per interaction, and drive the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and spend.

 - Explore where AI capability goes next, from fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to distillation and emerging foundation models, and turn a broad field of options into a small number of well-scoped bets, starting with internal productivity.
   


QUALIFICATIONS
